description: Illustrative operational zones used to exercise ORCA's geofencing, alerting and route-avoidance logic. Geometries are approximate rectangles chosen for demonstration. They are NOT official notified areas. Each entry names the authoritative dataset that should replace it.

layers.name: IMD marine bulletin sea areas (approximate)
layers.source: Approximated from the named sea areas used in IMD marine/coastal bulletins
layers.notes: Bounding boxes only. Replace with IMD's published sea-area definitions when obtained.

layers.name: Demonstration restricted / caution areas
layers.notes: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Replace with notified restricted areas, defence practice areas and port limits from the relevant authority before any operational use.

layers.notes: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Actual monsoon fishing-ban periods and areas are notified by individual coastal states and by the Government of India for the EEZ.
